notes.title: Protocol v3.0 summary
notes.content: Phase II trial of tarlozumab in advanced solid tumours opened under protocol v3.0 on 2026-01-15. Primary endpoint: objective response rate at 12 weeks. Secondary endpoint: progression-free survival at 6 months.

notes.title: Initial eligibility criteria v3.0
notes.content: Inclusion: ECOG performance status 0-2, age 18-65, measurable disease per RECIST 1.1, adequate organ function. Exclusion: prior anti-PD-1 therapy within 6 months.

notes.title: Patient-14 enrolment
notes.content: Patient-14 enrolled on 2026-01-15 into Cohort A (tarlozumab monotherapy). Inclusion criteria met under protocol v3.0. ECOG 1, age 58.

notes.title: Adverse event grading reference
notes.content: All adverse events to be graded per CTCAE v5.0 throughout the trial. Reporting via the OnCore EDC system within 24 hours for grade 3+ events.

notes.title: Patient-7 enrolment
notes.content: Patient-7 enrolled 2026-02-02 into Cohort A. ECOG 0, age 62. Inclusion under protocol v3.0; no concomitant medications of concern.

notes.title: Patient-14 first dose
notes.content: Patient-14 received first tarlozumab infusion on 2026-02-02 at the protocol-specified 200 mg q3w dose. Tolerated without infusion-reaction events; vital signs stable.

notes.title: Vemexine specification (rescue agent)
notes.content: Vemexine 50 mg PRN reserved as the cohort B rescue agent for tarlozumab-related infusion reactions. Not stocked at the cohort A site as of 2026-02-02.

notes.title: Pharmacokinetic sampling schedule v3.0
notes.content: PK samples drawn pre-dose, 1h, 4h, and 24h post-infusion at cycle 1 day 1 only. Trough levels at each subsequent cycle. Schedule per protocol v3.0 §7.4.

notes.title: Amendment v3.2 — upper age limit raised
notes.content: Protocol amendment v3.2 effective 2026-02-20. Upper age limit for inclusion raised from 65 to 75 to broaden enrolment to fit the population data. All other eligibility criteria unchanged.

notes.title: Cohort A dosing schedule
notes.content: Cohort A receives tarlozumab 200 mg by IV infusion every three weeks (q3w) for up to 12 cycles, with dose modifications per the toxicity table in protocol §6.3.

notes.title: Cohort A roster (as of 2026-02-20)
notes.content: Cohort A active participants: Patient-7 (enrolled 2026-02-02), Patient-14 (enrolled 2026-01-15). Both currently on study.

notes.title: Patient-22 enrolment
notes.content: Patient-22 enrolled 2026-03-05 into Cohort B (tarlozumab plus vemexine combination). ECOG 1, age 71. Eligibility confirmed under amendment v3.2 raised age limit.

notes.title: DSMB Q1 2026 outcome
notes.content: Data Safety Monitoring Board Q1 2026 review held 2026-03-04. Outcome: no safety signals warranting protocol modification. Continue per current protocol.

notes.title: Cohort B opens for enrolment
notes.content: Cohort B opened for enrolment on 2026-03-05 following protocol §3.2 milestone (Cohort A first cycle complete without grade-4 events). Combination arm uses tarlozumab plus vemexine rescue.

notes.title: Cohort B dosing schedule
notes.content: Cohort B dosing begins 30 days post-enrolment to allow drug-interaction screening and baseline PK. Dose: tarlozumab 200 mg q3w plus vemexine 50 mg PRN per investigator discretion for grade 2+ infusion reactions.

notes.title: Amendment v3.4 — ECOG range expanded
notes.content: Protocol amendment v3.4 effective 2026-03-20. ECOG performance status inclusion range expanded from 0-2 to 0-3 following Q1 DSMB review. Justification: enrol patients with worse performance status who remain candidates for systemic therapy.

notes.title: Patient-7 grade-2 fatigue AE
notes.content: Patient-7 reported grade-2 fatigue beginning 2026-03-15, attributed by investigator as possibly related to tarlozumab. No dose modification required per protocol toxicity table. Symptomatic management ongoing.

notes.title: Patient-14 grade-3 neutropenia and dose hold
notes.content: Patient-14 developed grade-3 neutropenia (ANC 0.8) on 2026-03-18 after cycle 3. Tarlozumab dose held per protocol §6.3 dose-modification rules. G-CSF support initiated. Recovery expected within 7-10 days.

notes.title: Vemexine availability extended to Cohort A
notes.content: As of 2026-03-20 vemexine 50 mg PRN is now stocked at all sites and available as a rescue agent for any cohort experiencing grade 2+ infusion reactions, not only Cohort B. Decision driven by site-monitoring feedback.

notes.title: Patient-31 enrolment
notes.content: Patient-31 enrolled 2026-04-02 into Cohort B. ECOG 2, age 68. Eligibility confirmed under amendments v3.2 (age) and v3.4 (ECOG range).

notes.title: Patient-22 first dose
notes.content: Patient-22 received first tarlozumab plus vemexine PRN combination dose on 2026-04-04, 30 days after enrolment per Cohort B protocol. No infusion reaction; vemexine not administered.

notes.title: Cohort B PK results — initial
notes.content: Cohort B initial PK from Patient-22 cycle 1: tarlozumab Cmax 78 µg/mL at 1h, AUC 0-24h 645 µg·h/mL. Within expected range from Cohort A monotherapy data.

notes.title: DSMB schedule revision
notes.content: DSMB cadence revised on 2026-04-02 from quarterly to bi-monthly through end of 2026 following Q1 review recommendation. Rationale: closer monitoring as Cohort B accrues.

notes.title: Amendment v4.0 — tertiary endpoint added
notes.content: Protocol amendment v4.0 effective 2026-04-15. Tertiary endpoint added to capture quality-of-life data via the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument at baseline, week 12, and end-of-treatment. Existing primary and secondary endpoints unchanged.

notes.title: Tertiary endpoint definition
notes.content: Tertiary endpoint per amendment v4.0: change from baseline in EORTC QLQ-C30 global health status / QoL score at week 12 and end-of-treatment. Mean change with 95% CI to be reported per cohort.

notes.title: Patient-22 grade-1 nausea AE
notes.content: Patient-22 reported grade-1 nausea beginning 2026-04-12 following cycle 2. Resolved within 48 hours with standard antiemetics. No dose modification; continue per schedule.

notes.title: Cohort C planning notes
notes.content: Cohort C (tarlozumab plus standard-of-care chemotherapy) planning underway as of 2026-04-15. Anticipated open date end of Q2 2026 pending DSMB sign-off and supply of co-administered SoC agent.

notes.title: Cohort A PK results — pooled cycles 1-3
notes.content: Pooled Cohort A PK across Patient-7 and Patient-14 cycles 1-3: mean Cmax 82 µg/mL, mean AUC 0-24h 689 µg·h/mL, trough at cycle 3 averaging 12 µg/mL. Consistent with prior Phase I data.

notes.title: Patient-14 PK April update
notes.content: Patient-14 PK at cycle 3 (drawn 2026-04-22 during dose-hold recovery): trough 8 µg/mL. Lower than Cohort A average reflecting the held dose. Resume dosing planned once ANC recovers above 1.5.

notes.title: Patient-7 PK April update
notes.content: Patient-7 PK at cycle 4 (drawn 2026-04-22): trough 14 µg/mL, on schedule. No PK-related dose adjustment indicated.

notes.title: Patient-14 dose resumption
notes.content: Patient-14 ANC recovered to 1.8 on 2026-04-25. Tarlozumab dosing resumed at the same 200 mg q3w dose per protocol §6.3 (no permanent reduction required after first grade-3 neutropenia event).

notes.title: Patient-45 screening
notes.content: Patient-45 screened 2026-05-01 for potential Cohort C enrolment. ECOG 3, age 73. Eligible under current amendments v3.2 (age 75 ceiling) and v3.4 (ECOG 0-3 range). Awaiting Cohort C open.

notes.title: Amendment v4.1 — PK schedule clarification
notes.content: Protocol amendment v4.1 effective 2026-05-01. PK sampling schedule clarified: pre-dose, 1h, 4h, 8h, and 24h post-infusion at cycle 1 day 1 (8h timepoint added). Subsequent-cycle troughs unchanged.

notes.title: Site monitoring visit findings
notes.content: Site monitoring visit conducted 2026-04-29. Findings: source-data verification 100% match for the 4 active patients; one minor query on PK draw timing for Patient-22 cycle 1 (resolved). No major or critical findings.

notes.title: AE grading scale update to CTCAE v5.1
notes.content: Effective 2026-05-01 all adverse events to be graded per CTCAE v5.1 in line with sponsor-wide harmonisation. Replaces the v5.0 reference active since trial open. Existing AE records remapped per the v5.0→v5.1 crosswalk.

notes.title: Cohort B status update
notes.content: Cohort B status as of 2026-05-05: 2 active participants (Patient-22, Patient-31). No grade 3+ AEs reported in Cohort B to date. Vemexine PRN not yet required for any combination dose.

notes.title: Cohort C status update — open delayed
notes.content: Cohort C open date pushed from end-Q2 to mid-Q3 2026 per 2026-05-05 update. Driver: standard-of-care agent supply chain delay. Patient-45 screening remains valid for 60 days.

notes.title: Cohort B roster (as of 2026-05-05)
notes.content: Cohort B active participants: Patient-22 (enrolled 2026-03-05, dosing since 2026-04-04), Patient-31 (enrolled 2026-04-02, dosing scheduled 2026-05-02). Both on study.

notes.title: Missing-data audit summary
notes.content: Quarterly missing-data audit completed 2026-05-05. Overall completeness 99.2% across all CRFs and patients. Two missing PK timepoints (Patient-22 cycle 1 4h, resolved by site visit) and one missing QLQ-C30 baseline (Patient-31, captured retrospectively under v4.0).
